title: Comparative analysis and validation of the malachite green assay for the high throughput biochemical characterization of terpene synthases
author: Vardakou, Salmon, et al.

steps.title: Express recombinant terpene synthases
steps.instruction: Produce the three terpene synthases (AaFS, AaADS, TEAS) in E. coli BL21 (DE3) using pH9GW vectors and harvest the cells for downstream purification.

substeps.instruction: Transform pH9GW constructs into E. coli BL21 (DE3) and plate on LB agar containing kanamycin (50 µg/mL).
Inoculate a starter culture and grow in Terrific Broth (TB) with kanamycin (50 µg/mL) at 37 °C until OD600 ≥ 0.8.
Induce protein expression by adding IPTG to a final concentration of 0.1 mM; continue shaking incubation for 5 h at 20 °C.
Harvest cells by centrifugation.
Resuspend cell pellets in 50 mL buffer A (50 mM Tris‑HCl, 50 mM glycine, 5 % glycerol, 0.5 M NaCl, 20 mM imidazole, pH 8) supplemented with an EDTA‑free protease‑inhibitor tablet.

steps.title: Purify proteins via FPLC
steps.instruction: Lyse the harvested cells and purify each terpene synthase using a two‑step Ni²⁺‑IMAC followed by size‑exclusion chromatography.

substeps.instruction: Lyse cells with a cell disruptor at 25 kpsi; clarify the lysate by centrifugation.
Load the clarified lysate onto a 5 mL Ni²⁺‑IMAC HisTrap™ HP column equilibrated with buffer A using an AKTAxpress system.
Elute the bound protein and immediately load the eluate onto an S200 26/60 Sephadex gel‑filtration column equilibrated with 20 mM HEPES, 0.15 M NaCl, pH 7.5.
Collect fractions and determine protein concentration with the Bradford assay.
Assess purity of the pooled fractions by SDS‑PAGE.

steps.title: Prepare and grow mutant cultures
steps.instruction: Generate mutant TPS libraries in BL21 (DE3), grow them in 24‑well plates, induce expression, and harvest cells for screening.

substeps.instruction: Transform mutant plasmids into BL21 (DE3) and spread onto LB agar plates containing kanamycin.
Pick individual colonies into 3 mL LB with kanamycin in 24‑well plates; incubate overnight at 37 °C, 230 rpm.
Dilute 0.5 mL of each overnight culture into 5 mL TB with kanamycin; grow in 24‑well round‑bottom plates sealed with micro‑porous tape at 37 °C until OD600 ≥ 0.8.
Induce protein expression by adding IPTG to 0.1 mM and shift the temperature to 20 °C for 5 h.
Harvest cells by centrifugation and store pellets at –20 °C until purification.

steps.title: Lyse cells and treat lysate
steps.instruction: Resuspend frozen pellets, lyse with lysozyme, and digest nucleic acids with benzonase before affinity capture.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend each pellet at 25 °C in 0.8 mL lysis buffer (50 mM Tris‑HCl, 500 mM NaCl, 20 mM imidazole, 10 % glycerol v/v, 10 mM β‑mercaptoethanol, 1 % Tween‑20, pH 8) containing lysozyme (1 mg/mL) and 1 mM EDTA; incubate 30 min.
Add 10 µL benzonase solution (850 mM MgCl₂, 3.78 U/µL benzonase) and shake at 250 rpm for 15 min.

steps.title: Ni‑NTA purification in 96‑well format
steps.instruction: Capture, wash, and elute His‑tagged proteins from lysate using superflow Ni‑NTA resin in a 96‑well vacuum manifold, then quantify protein.

substeps.instruction: Aliquot lysate into 400 µL portions and pass each through a Whatman Unifilter 96‑well plate; collect flow‑through in a second plate containing 50 µL bed‑volume of superflow Ni‑NTA resin pre‑equilibrated with lysis buffer, using a vacuum manifold.
Wash each well with lysis buffer three times (3 × 500 µL).
Wash each well with wash buffer (lysis buffer without Tween‑20) three times (3 × 500 µL).
Air‑dry the resin briefly, then add 150 µL elution buffer (wash buffer containing 250 mM imidazole).
Centrifuge the plate at 1500 rpm for 2 min; collect eluate.
Repeat the elution step once more with the same conditions.
Measure the concentration of the pooled eluates using the Bradford method.
